title: Bitget Wallet Card Adds Bitcoin, Gold and Tokenized Stock Cashback
summary:
Bitget Wallet's Assetback programme converts card rewards into Bitcoin, gold or tokenized equities automatically, with up to 3% cashback across 50-plus markets.
The post Bitget Wallet Card Adds Bitcoin, Gold and Tokenized Stock Cashback appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Bitget Wallet has expanded its card rewards program, allowing users to earn cashback converted automatically into Bitcoin, gold, or tokenized stocks. The newly introduced Assetback programme offers up to 3 percent cashback across more than 50 markets, providing cardholders with diversified reward options directly integrated into their spending experience.
